findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "account-abstraction" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: account-abstraction_paymaster-sponsorship-audit, account-abstraction_sponsorship-risk, account-abstraction_user-operation-audit, account-abstraction_user-op-validity · Public sink: account-abstraction_paymaster-sponsorship-audit, account-abstraction_sponsorship-risk, account-abstraction_user-operation-audit, account-abstraction_user-op-validity · Destructive: account-abstraction_paymaster-sponsorship-audit, account-abstraction_sponsorship-risk, account-abstraction_user-operation-audit, account-abstraction_user-op-validity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: account-abstraction_paymaster-sponsorship-audit, account-abstraction_sponsorship-risk, account-abstraction_user-operation-audit, account-abstraction_user-op-validity · Public sink: account-abstraction_paymaster-sponsorship-audit, account-abstraction_sponsorship-risk, account-abstraction_user-operation-audit, account-abstraction_user-op-validity · Destructive: account-abstraction_paymaster-sponsorship-audit, account-abstraction_sponsorship-risk, account-abstraction_user-operation-audit, account-abstraction_user-op-validity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
